reviews.title: Essential for Any Gamer’s Setup!
reviews.comment: The Corsair MM700 RGB extended mouse pad is fantastic. It delivers exceptional tracking, allowing my mouse to glide effortlessly while maintaining extreme accuracy. No matter which mouse I use, the performance remains consistently smooth and precise. Vibrant RGB & Customization One of the standout features is the RGB lighting, which is incredibly vibrant. The Corsair iCUE software offers a wide range of settings and lighting effects, making it easy to customize the look to match any setup. Whether you prefer dynamic effects or a static glow, the options are plentiful. Built-in USB Hub – A Welcome Addition A major highlight is the built-in USB port, adding extra convenience. Whether you need to plug in a flash drive, wireless mouse dongle, headset receiver, or any other USB accessory, the extra port is a thoughtful and practical feature. Premium Build & Gaming Performance The material quality is top-tier, offering a smooth yet durable surface that feels premium. As someone who plays a lot of FPS games like The Finals, Call of Duty, and Destiny 2, I can confidently say this mouse pad has been a game-changer. My shots feel more precise, and overall, my gameplay has improved thanks to the consistent tracking and smooth glide. Final Verdict: A Must-Have for Gamers If you're looking for an RGB extended mouse pad that combines performance, aesthetics, and convenience, the Corsair MM700 is a fantastic choice. The accurate tracking, vibrant lighting, and built-in USB hub make it an essential addition to any gaming setup. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Mr. Next Level

reviews.title: Large, Smooth, and Looks Awesome
reviews.comment: The Corsair MM700 RGB Extended Cloth Gaming Mouse Pad is excellent. The surface is smooth and consistent, perfect for both gaming and everyday work. The 360° RGB lighting looks great and adds a nice aesthetic without being distracting. The size is ideal—it easily fits a keyboard and mouse with plenty of room to spare. The pad lays flat, doesn’t slide around, and feels well made overall. Setup is easy, and RGB controls work smoothly. Overall, this mouse pad is high quality, functional, and visually impressive. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Purpose Over Popularity

reviews.title: MM700 is a beast mat!
reviews.comment: Let me start by saying I notice other reviewers say they have difficulty with it never lying flat. A lot of RGB mousepads have the issues because of the way the plastic RGB outline and cloth are woven creating the tension to where it sits in one place so this is pretty common. All you have to do is keep heavy items sit on the non flattened parts to help it then after days or weeks of it helping all it can, all you need to do is bend the plastic rgb out layer a little but be careful not to do it to much as idk if it messes with the electronics. Ive experienced cheap ones and this is by far the best! Spend a little extra and get this one for sure. RGB is nice and bright. Software is kinda confusing with some features but not necessary either so not a big deal for me. The glide is nice and smooth/medium speed while being plush enough with the 4mm thickness to allow stopping power. USB hub on the mat! Cleaning the mat is super simple as well. All around good mat! Got it on sale for about 45$ so it was def a steal for me! Okay guys so I wrote this review in 2023 and I actually returned it for highly recommended X-raypad ROB Strata Aqua Control Plus wich had the coolest design I've ever seen and I still have it but now I've re bought this mm700 because the texture is way better IMO. The ROB was to rough for my liking and I feel like it gave my aim jitters. As you can see in the pic I've now added this pic here in 2024 and this is brand new out the box and I had heavy items sit on some edges for only a day and then bent the rgb strip so it sits flat and here it is after one day. This pad is perfect!

reviews.title: Big, Bright, and Makes Your Setup Look Awesome
reviews.comment: Picked this up and it’s been a really nice upgrade to the desk. It’s big enough to fit everything—keyboard, mouse, and still plenty of room left. Makes the whole setup feel more put together instead of pieces scattered around. The surface is smooth and works great for both gaming and everyday use. The RGB is the real standout though. It wraps all the way around and actually looks good, not cheesy. You can customize it or just leave it on a preset and it still looks great. Build quality feels solid too, and it stays in place without sliding around. Overall, looks great, works great, and just makes your setup feel a little more finished.
